description:
Reuse the existing verified applied-profile repository fixtures for CLI and warning tests whose initial profile application is only setup, reducing critical-path work without changing the operation or assertion under test.

## Background

Seven profiled identities spend 47,286 aggregate warm milliseconds repeating default or dogfood profile installation before testing later repair, validation, dry-run, event, taxonomy, or warning behavior. The default and dogfood immutable baselines already exist, are provenance-keyed, and are cloned into isolated mutable repositories. Fresh, partial, conflicting, compositional, pack/add, and initial-application tests remain excluded because their starting shape or first application is material.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Exactly three CLI profile workflow identities and four fast-rules warning identities replace only their prerequisite profile installation with isolated clones of the existing verified default or dogfood baseline.
- [hard] REQ-02: Preserves every stable test identity and all real CLI operations, mutations, event assertions, profile-record assertions, validation assertions, graph-rule evaluation, taxonomy, and warning assertions after setup.
- [hard] REQ-03: Uses the existing run-bound SHA-verified receipts and direct-Cargo fallback without adding a fixture recipe, and exact nextest filters activate setup only for the seven named consumers.
- [hard] REQ-04: Fresh, absent-root, partial-init, conflict, concurrent publication, initial-application, composition, pack/add, and package-provenance tests remain on their authored setup paths.
- [hard] REQ-05: Setup-inclusive selected-family timing demonstrates at least 30,000 aggregate milliseconds saved from the recorded 47,286-millisecond baseline, with no selected-family wall regression; focused tests, fixture integrity, formatting, and warning-free linting pass.

## Notes

The intended footprint is `.config/nextest.toml`, `crates/jit/tests/cli_repo_workflow/main.rs`, `crates/jit/tests/cli_repo_workflow/profile_cli_tests.rs`, and `crates/jit/tests/fast_rules/cli_warnings_integration_tests.rs`. No production code or new cache format is expected.
title: Reuse applied profile baselines for CLI prerequisites
